svg.aria-label: A fantasy map of my journey: a tunnel dug from Alexandria down through the Forges of Training into the Heart of the Core (ITI, Tekomoro, elmenus, Omdena), then back up through the Kingdoms of Clusters to the Realm of Silicon (KAUST, ESPRIT, SDAIA, Core42). Beyond the map: Here be LLMOps.

g.text: as travelled by Ahmed Yousri Sobhi, anno 2014 to the present day
